display.label: Local Network Gateway
display.description: Azure Local Network Gateway representing an on-premises VPN device for Site-to-Site VPN connections

resource.key_description: The unique name for the Azure Local Network Gateway. Serves as the map key.

sections.label: Basic Configuration
sections.description: Core Local Network Gateway identity and regional placement settings.

fields.label: Local Network Gateway Name
fields.description: Name of the Azure Local Network Gateway. Must be between 1 and 80 characters, begin with an alphanumeric character, end with an alphanumeric character or underscore, and contain only alphanumerics, hyphens, periods, or underscores.

validation.pattern_error: Local Network Gateway name must be between 1 and 80 characters, begin with an alphanumeric character, end with an alphanumeric character or underscore, and contain only alphanumerics, hyphens, periods, or underscores.

fields.label: Resource Group Name
fields.description: The name of the Resource Group in which to create the Local Network Gateway.

fields.label: Region
fields.description: The Azure Region where the Local Network Gateway should be created.

sections.label: Gateway Connectivity & Address Spaces
sections.description: Connection endpoints and on-premises IP address ranges.

fields.label: Gateway IP Address
fields.description: The public IPv4 address of the on-premises VPN device. Specify either Gateway Address or Gateway FQDN.

validation.pattern_error: Must be a valid IPv4 address (e.g., 198.51.100.1).

fields.label: Gateway FQDN
fields.description: The Fully Qualified Domain Name of the on-premises VPN device. Specify either Gateway Address or Gateway FQDN.

fields.label: Address Space CIDRs
fields.description: List of CIDR blocks representing the on-premises address spaces routed through this gateway (e.g. 10.0.0.0/16).

sections.label: BGP Routing Settings
sections.description: Border Gateway Protocol (BGP) routing configuration for the Local Network Gateway.

fields.label: BGP Configuration
fields.description: BGP settings block for dynamic routing with on-premises BGP peer.

fields.label: Autonomous System Number (ASN)
fields.description: The Autonomous System Number of the on-premises BGP Speaker (e.g. 65510).

fields.label: BGP Peering IP Address
fields.description: The IP address of the on-premises BGP speaker.

fields.label: Peer Weight
fields.description: The weight added to routes learned from this BGP Speaker.

sections.label: Tagging
sections.description: Resource tags for governance and billing.

fields.label: Tags
fields.description: Key-value pairs to assign to the Local Network Gateway.
